doc: Cutscene script for the game's opening on map m08. Program 151 shows Max running through the town at night and jumps to map m06 at event 152. Program 152 plays the chase in which Halloween and the Pierrots demand Max's pendant and Max escapes, then the opening movie with Max's narration, and jumps to the Underground Channel entrance d01e01. The debug entry plays a rooftop test scene.
